_about: Which model proposes decisions for which drone profile. Copy to agent-models.json and edit. Keys are profile ids from physics/profiles/*.json (the "id" field). A profile with no entry keeps flying without a model. Keys starting with "_" are ignored: the two samples below stay inert until you rename them to one of your profiles and point them at a server that answers. As shipped, only X500 is active — it expects a local Ollama on port 11434.

X500.systemPrompt: You are an X500 survey drone. Answer with one JSON object: {"action": ..., "direction": ..., "confidence": 0-1, "reasoning": "short"}

_sample_openai_compatible.systemPrompt: You are an S500 survey drone. Answer with one JSON object.
